from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from collections import Counter
from itertools import combinations
import hashlib,json,math,sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/"reports/research/510300_multidim_shared_evidence_attribution_v1"
PROTOCOL=json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if (OUT/"result.json").exists():
    raise RuntimeError("已存在归因结果，禁止覆盖或重复运行。")
STARTED=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for item in PROTOCOL["source_receipts"]:
    if sha(ROOT/item["path"])!=item["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("固定输入已经改变："+item["path"])
authority_snapshots={item["path"]:(ROOT/item["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig") for item in PROTOCOL["source_receipts"] if item["path"].startswith("config/")}
calendar=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.read_parquet(ROOT/"reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/daily_inputs_corrected_20240808.parquet",columns=["date"]).date).normalize()
if not calendar.is_unique or not calendar.is_monotonic_increasing:
    raise ValueError("交易日历重复或无序。")
CALENDAR_SET=set(calendar.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
def day(value):
    return pd.Timestamp(value).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
def moment(value):
    stamp=pd.Timestamp(value)
    return stamp.tz_localize("Asia/Shanghai") if stamp.tzinfo is None else stamp.tz_convert("Asia/Shanghai")
def entry_moment(row):
    return moment(row["entry_at"]) if "entry_at" in row and pd.notna(row["entry_at"]) else moment(day(row["entry_date"])+" 09:30:00")
def observation(row):
    return day(row["entry_date"])+"→"+day(row["exit_date"])
interval_cache={}
def intervals(entry,exit_date):
    key=(entry,exit_date)
    if key not in interval_cache:
        if entry not in CALENDAR_SET or exit_date not in CALENDAR_SET:
            raise ValueError("持有窗口缺少交易日："+str(key))
        interval_cache[key]=set(calendar[(calendar>=pd.Timestamp(entry))&(calendar<pd.Timestamp(exit_date))].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
    return interval_cache[key]
def route(tree,row):
    node=0
    path=[]
    while tree["children_left"][node]!=-1:
        feature=tree["features"][tree["feature"][node]]
        raw=float(row[feature])
        value=float(np.float32(raw))
        threshold=float(tree["threshold"][node])
        go_left=value<=threshold
        path.append({"feature":feature,"value":raw,"tree_value_float32":value,"threshold":threshold,"branch":"<=" if go_left else ">"})
        node=tree["children_left"][node] if go_left else tree["children_right"][node]
    return node,path
def finite(value):
    return None if value is None or not np.isfinite(value) else float(value)
def fraction(a,b):
    return float(a/b) if abs(b)>1e-12 else None
def clean(obj):
    if isinstance(obj,dict):
        return {str(k):clean(v) for k,v in obj.items()}
    if isinstance(obj,(list,tuple)):
        return [clean(v) for v in obj]
    if isinstance(obj,(np.integer,)):
        return int(obj)
    if isinstance(obj,(np.bool_,)):
        return bool(obj)
    if isinstance(obj,(np.floating,float)):
        return finite(obj)
    if isinstance(obj,(pd.Timestamp,datetime)):
        return obj.isoformat()
    return obj
def save_json(name,value):
    (OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(clean(value),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
def save_csv(name,frame):
    frame.to_csv(OUT/name,index=False,encoding="utf-8-sig")
NEW_FIELDS={"M2":["M2公布相对事前预期"],"LOAN":["贷款预期偏差超出显示精度的余额基点"],"PUBLIC_FUND":["开放式股票基金份额月变","开放式混合基金份额月变"]}
summaries=[]
members_all=[]
opportunities=[]
paths_all=[]
checks={"predictions":0,"leaf_members":0,"max_leaf_mean_error":0.0,"max_tree_value_error":0.0,"max_score_error":0.0,"training_maturity_violations":0,"source_clock_violations":0,"changed_saved_high_count":0,"float32_feature_mismatches":0}
original_counts={}
for spec in PROTOCOL["specs"]:
    base=ROOT/spec["base"]
    events=pd.read_parquet(base/spec["events"])
    predictions=pd.read_csv(base/spec["predictions"])
    models=json.loads((base/"saved_models.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    original_high=pd.read_csv(base/"全部固定高分机会.csv")
    original_high=original_high.loc[original_high.model.eq("joint")].copy()
    if len(models)!=spec["expected_predictions"] or len(predictions)!=spec["expected_predictions"]:
        raise ValueError("原评分数量不符："+spec["id"])
    if not events.stat_month.is_unique or not predictions.stat_month.is_unique:
        raise ValueError("月度键重复："+spec["id"])
    by_month=events.set_index("stat_month",drop=False)
    pred_by_month=predictions.set_index("stat_month",drop=False)
    model_by_month={m["stat_month"]:m for m in models}
    if set(model_by_month)!=set(pred_by_month.index):
        raise ValueError("保存模型与评分月份不符。")
    high_months=set(original_high.stat_month)
    selected_replay=[]
    next_exit=moment("1900-01-01")
    for _,score_row in predictions.iterrows():
        current=by_month.loc[score_row.stat_month]
        model=model_by_month[score_row.stat_month]
        tree=model["joint_tree"]
        cutoff=moment(current.decision_at)
        pool=by_month.loc[model["training_months"]]
        if score_row.stat_month in model["training_months"] or len(pool)!=int(score_row.training_events):
            raise ValueError("保存训练池数量或自包含错误。")
        if not all(moment(x)<=cutoff for x in pool.exit_at):
            checks["training_maturity_violations"]+=1
            raise ValueError("训练标签尚未成熟。")
        if not pool.state_idx.ge(float(current.state_idx)-504).all():
            raise ValueError("训练标签超过原504交易日窗口。")
        for field in ["known_at","available_at","actual_known_at","prior_stock_known_at","state_available_at","funding_available_at","orders_available_at"]:
            if field in current and pd.notna(current[field]) and moment(current[field])>cutoff:
                checks["source_clock_violations"]+=1
                raise ValueError("当前源可得时点晚于决定："+field)
        if entry_moment(current)<=cutoff:
            raise ValueError("入场不晚于决定。")
        for field in tree["features"]:
            if np.float32(current[field])!=np.float32(score_row[field]):
                checks["float32_feature_mismatches"]+=1
                raise ValueError("评分CSV与原输入的float32特征不同："+field)
        leaf,path=route(tree,current)
        pool_leaves=[route(tree,r)[0] for _,r in pool.iterrows()]
        leaf_members=pool.loc[np.asarray(pool_leaves)==leaf].copy()
        if len(leaf_members)!=tree["samples"][leaf]:
            raise ValueError("恢复叶成员与保存samples不同。")
        mean=float(leaf_members.actual_net5.mean())
        replay=float(tree["value"][leaf])
        error=abs(mean-float(score_row.joint_prediction))
        tree_error=abs(replay-float(score_row.joint_prediction))
        fitted=np.array([tree["value"][n] for n in pool_leaves],dtype=float)
        replay_score=float(100*((fitted<replay).mean()+0.5*(fitted==replay).mean()))
        score_error=abs(replay_score-float(score_row.joint_score))
        checks["max_leaf_mean_error"]=max(checks["max_leaf_mean_error"],error)
        checks["max_tree_value_error"]=max(checks["max_tree_value_error"],tree_error)
        checks["max_score_error"]=max(checks["max_score_error"],score_error)
        if max(error,tree_error)>PROTOCOL["tree_replay"]["prediction_tolerance"] or score_error>PROTOCOL["tree_replay"]["score_tolerance"]:
            raise ValueError("保存预测或分数不能重现。")
        label_sum=float(leaf_members.actual_net5.sum())
        positive=leaf_members.loc[leaf_members.actual_net5.gt(0)]
        pos_sum=float(positive.actual_net5.sum())
        biggest=positive.loc[positive.actual_net5.idxmax()] if len(positive) else None
        largest_abs=leaf_members.loc[leaf_members.actual_net5.abs().idxmax()]
        source_clock=current["known_at"] if "known_at" in current else current["available_at"]
        used=list(dict.fromkeys(c["feature"] for c in path))
        path_news=[f for f in NEW_FIELDS[spec["id"]] if f in used]
        tree_news=[f for f in NEW_FIELDS[spec["id"]] if f in tree["used_features"]]
        own=observation(current)
        held=intervals(day(current.entry_date),day(current.exit_date))
        if len(held)!=5:
            raise ValueError("原五个开盘间隔长度不符。")
        summary={"study":spec["id"],"study_name":spec["name"],"stat_month":score_row.stat_month,"era":score_row.era,
                 "source_known_at":moment(source_clock).isoformat(),"decision_at":cutoff.isoformat(),
                 "entry_date":day(current.entry_date),"exit_date":day(current.exit_date),"observation_id":own,
                 "actual_net5":float(current.actual_net5),"prediction":float(score_row.joint_prediction),"score":float(score_row.joint_score),
                 "training_n":len(pool),"training_max_exit_at":max(moment(x) for x in pool.exit_at).isoformat(),
                 "leaf_id":leaf,"leaf_n":len(leaf_members),"leaf_mean":mean,"leaf_signed_sum":label_sum,"leaf_positive_sum":pos_sum,
                 "path_features":"；".join(used),"new_field_on_path":"；".join(path_news),"new_field_in_tree":"；".join(tree_news),
                 "path_conditions":json.dumps(path,ensure_ascii=False),"largest_positive_observation":observation(biggest) if biggest is not None else None,
                 "largest_positive_stat_month":biggest.stat_month if biggest is not None else None,
                 "largest_positive_entry":day(biggest.entry_date) if biggest is not None else None,
                 "largest_positive_exit":day(biggest.exit_date) if biggest is not None else None,
                 "largest_positive_net5":float(biggest.actual_net5) if biggest is not None else None,
                 "largest_positive_signed_share":fraction(float(biggest.actual_net5),label_sum) if biggest is not None else None,
                 "largest_positive_positive_share":fraction(float(biggest.actual_net5),pos_sum) if biggest is not None else None,
                 "largest_absolute_observation":observation(largest_abs),"largest_absolute_net5":float(largest_abs.actual_net5),
                 "largest_absolute_abs_sum_share":fraction(abs(float(largest_abs.actual_net5)),float(leaf_members.actual_net5.abs().sum())),
                 "original_selected_high":score_row.stat_month in high_months,
                 "leaf_observation_ids":"；".join(observation(r) for _,r in leaf_members.iterrows()),
                 "source_url":str(current["source_url"] if "source_url" in current else current["url"]),
                 "forecast_url":str(current.get("forecast_url",""))}
        summaries.append(summary)
        paths_all.append({"study":spec["id"],"stat_month":score_row.stat_month,"leaf":leaf,"path":path})
        for _,member in leaf_members.iterrows():
            members_all.append({"study":spec["id"],"prediction_stat_month":score_row.stat_month,
                "prediction_era":score_row.era,"prediction_decision_at":cutoff.isoformat(),"prediction_selected_high":score_row.stat_month in high_months,
                "member_stat_month":member.stat_month,"member_observation":observation(member),"member_entry":day(member.entry_date),
                "member_exit":day(member.exit_date),"member_exit_at":moment(member.exit_at).isoformat(),
                "member_net5":float(member.actual_net5),"leaf_n":len(leaf_members),
                "contribution_to_leaf_mean":float(member.actual_net5)/len(leaf_members),
                "is_largest_positive":biggest is not None and member.stat_month==biggest.stat_month,
                **{f:float(member[f]) for f in tree["features"]}})
        if cutoff>=next_exit and float(score_row.joint_score)>=80 and float(score_row.joint_prediction)>0:
            selected_replay.append(score_row.stat_month)
            next_exit=moment(current.exit_at)
        if score_row.stat_month in high_months:
            opportunities.append(summary.copy())
        checks["predictions"]+=1
        checks["leaf_members"]+=len(leaf_members)
    if set(selected_replay)!=high_months or len(selected_replay)!=len(original_high):
        checks["changed_saved_high_count"]+=1
        raise ValueError("原不重叠高分机会不能重现。")
    for _,old in original_high.iterrows():
        current=by_month.loc[old.stat_month]
        if observation(current)!=day(old.entry_date)+"→"+day(old.exit_date) or abs(float(old.net_return)-float(current.actual_net5))>1e-12:
            raise ValueError("原高分窗口或原收益标签改变。")
    original_counts[spec["id"]]={"predictions":len(predictions),"selected_high":len(original_high),"primary_selected_high":int(original_high.era.eq("2024—2025").sum())}
all_frame=pd.DataFrame(summaries)
member_frame=pd.DataFrame(members_all)
high_frame=pd.DataFrame(opportunities)
if len(all_frame)!=101:
    raise ValueError("全样本数不是101。")
def relations(frame):
    result=[]
    for a,b in combinations(frame.to_dict("records"),2):
        ah=intervals(a["entry_date"],a["exit_date"])
        bh=intervals(b["entry_date"],b["exit_date"])
        common=ah&bh
        exact=a["observation_id"]==b["observation_id"]
        adjacent=not common and (a["exit_date"]==b["entry_date"] or b["exit_date"]==a["entry_date"])
        result.append({"study_a":a["study"],"month_a":a["stat_month"],"era_a":a["era"],"entry_a":a["entry_date"],"exit_a":a["exit_date"],
                       "study_b":b["study"],"month_b":b["stat_month"],"era_b":b["era"],"entry_b":b["entry_date"],"exit_b":b["exit_date"],
                       "cross_study":a["study"]!=b["study"],"relation":"完全相同" if exact else "部分重叠" if common else "相邻" if adjacent else "分离",
                       "common_holding_intervals":len(common),"jaccard":len(common)/len(ah|bh),
                       "common_interval_dates":"；".join(sorted(common))})
    return pd.DataFrame(result)
high_pairs=relations(high_frame)
all_pairs=relations(all_frame)
account_cycles=[]
account_overlap=[]
account_day_checks=[]
for capital in [200000,20000]:
    ledgers={}
    cycle_blocks={}
    for spec in PROTOCOL["specs"][:2]:
        base=ROOT/spec["account_base"]
        case=f"joint_{capital}"
        ledger=pd.read_parquet(base/"accounts"/(case+".parquet"))
        cycles=pd.read_csv(base/"全部账户自然交易周期.csv")
        cycles=cycles.loc[cycles.case_id.eq(case)].copy()
        ledger["day"]=pd.to_datetime(ledger.date).dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        held=set(ledger.loc[ledger.shares.gt(0),"day"])
        cycle_held=set()
        for _,c in cycles.iterrows():
            close=bool(c.closed)
            if not close:
                raise ValueError("本诊断遇到未结束原周期。")
            e,x=day(c.entry),day(c.exit)
            h=intervals(e,x)
            cycle_held|=h
            account_cycles.append({"study":spec["id"],"capital":capital,"case_id":case,"entry":e,"exit":x,
                "observation_id":e+"→"+x,"era":"2024—2025" if pd.Timestamp(e).year>=2024 else "2021—2023",
                "profit_cny":float(c.profit),"initial_quantity":int(c.initial_quantity),"paid_friction":float(c.paid_friction),
                "closed":close,"holding_intervals":len(h)})
        if held!=cycle_held:
            raise ValueError("实际保存持仓日与周期区间不符。")
        ledgers[spec["id"]]=ledger.set_index("day")
        cycle_blocks[spec["id"]]=cycles
        account_day_checks.append({"study":spec["id"],"capital":capital,"ledger_rows":len(ledger),"cycles":len(cycles),"holding_intervals":len(held),"cycle_ledger_same_holding_days":True})
    joined=ledgers["M2"][["shares","exposure"]].join(ledgers["LOAN"][["shares","exposure"]],how="outer",lsuffix="_m2",rsuffix="_loan")
    for era,start,end in [("完整期2021—2025","2021-01-01","2025-12-31"),("主要期2024—2025","2024-01-01","2025-12-31")]:
        sub=joined.loc[(joined.index>=start)&(joined.index<=end)]
        ma=sub.shares_m2.gt(0); lb=sub.shares_loan.gt(0)
        mcycles=cycle_blocks["M2"]; lcycles=cycle_blocks["LOAN"]
        mset={(day(c.entry),day(c.exit)) for _,c in mcycles.iterrows() if start<=day(c.entry)<=end}
        lset={(day(c.entry),day(c.exit)) for _,c in lcycles.iterrows() if start<=day(c.entry)<=end}
        account_overlap.append({"capital":capital,"era":era,"m2_cycles":len(mset),"loan_cycles":len(lset),
            "exact_shared_cycles":len(mset&lset),"unique_cycle_windows":len(mset|lset),
            "m2_holding_days":int(ma.sum()),"loan_holding_days":int(lb.sum()),"both_holding_days":int((ma&lb).sum()),
            "union_holding_days":int((ma|lb).sum()),"same_quantity_days_when_both":int((ma&lb&sub.shares_m2.eq(sub.shares_loan)).sum()),
            "pnl_scope":"仅读取保存账户，未相加利润、未重算夏普、未合成账户。"})
cycles_frame=pd.DataFrame(account_cycles)
usage=[]
for key,block in member_frame.groupby("member_observation",sort=True):
    labels=block.member_net5
    if float(labels.max()-labels.min())>1e-12:
        raise ValueError("同一入退出观察的标签不一致。")
    usage.append({"observation_id":key,"entry_date":block.member_entry.iloc[0],"exit_date":block.member_exit.iloc[0],
        "net5":float(labels.iloc[0]),"leaf_uses":len(block),"studies":"；".join(sorted(set(block.study))),
        "study_count":block.study.nunique(),"selected_high_leaf_uses":int(block.prediction_selected_high.sum()),
        "primary_selected_high_leaf_uses":int((block.prediction_selected_high&block.prediction_era.eq("2024—2025")).sum()),
        "largest_positive_uses":int(block.is_largest_positive.sum()),
        "primary_high_largest_positive_uses":int((block.is_largest_positive&block.prediction_selected_high&block.prediction_era.eq("2024—2025")).sum())})
usage_frame=pd.DataFrame(usage)
field_rows=[]
